scope: Targeted consumer/mechanism comparison, not novelty proof.

matches.matched_control: Physical W2 final-indicator-only intervention; equal mask/feature/coordinate moments, repeat, point permutation, translation, rotation and wrong-mask/pair controls. Native128/argmax/released backbone/seed1999/fixed30/auxiliary losses unchanged; no numeric search.

matches.hypothesis: Fixed focal query/masks/masses/overlap/counts and peer normalized weighted mean can hide changed peer feature second moments. Test representational capacity, not model harm or validation gain.

matches.hypothesis: Direct gradients from a focal confidence through peer query values couple rival representations. Isolating only that value-input path may change confidence learning while preserving every forward output and mask-overlap gradient. Task benefit is unmeasured.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2, shared indicator at all seven stages. Recompute the SAME trainable query LayerNorm on query.detach() for peer values only; retain focal input, mask gradients, affine/head parameter gradients, native targets, selector, losses, seed1999 and fixed30.

matches.hypothesis: The W2 confidence MLP receives focal and overlap-weighted peer vectors through concatenated normalized evidence. An explicit dense bilinear residual may make focal/peer cross-channel interactions easier to fit. The original MLP can represent interactions implicitly; this is an architectural optimization comparison, not a missing-information or efficacy claim.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus zero-initialized two-channel dense bilinear weights on normalized focal query and its existing overlap-weighted context, divided by sqrt(d_model). No extra RNG, new evidence statistics, thresholds, loss, selector, schedule, feature selection or numerical search. Keep all seven shared-head losses, released SPFormer, seed1999 and fixed30.

matches.hypothesis: W2 pools peers using symmetric soft point-mass IoU. A signed containment peer path may distinguish a focal mask containing a smaller peer from being contained by a larger peer, and make confidence fitting easier. Existing query features may implicitly encode size; missing information and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus zero-initialized 256x2 projection of signed peer context: sum_j [I_ij/A_j-I_ij/A_i] qnorm_j/(Q-1), self edges zero. All channels retained, no threshold, selector, new loss, epoch, seed or validation tuning; same seven shared confidence calls, released SPFormer and fixed30/seed1999.

matches.hypothesis: W2 uses overlap-weighted peer states only to read out confidence, while query refinement does not explicitly consume that competition context. A zero-initialized learned projection of full peer states into the next refinement may make masks and confidence co-adapt. Existing self-attention can represent peer interactions; neither missing information nor efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_next_input=q+C(q,masks,masses)@W, where C is the row-normalized off-diagonal soft point-mass-IoU weighted mean of raw peer queries. Shared W[256,256] starts at exact zero without RNG. Six feedback calls before coarse query-to-instance attention, seven unchanged confidence losses, released SPFormer, fixed30/seed1999 and native YAML.

matches.hypothesis: The existing maximum peer-overlap scalar enters a joint evidence LayerNorm and nonlinear confidence head. A separate zero-initialized two-output linear shortcut of that SAME scalar at all seven readouts may ease confidence fitting. The head already receives this information; no missing information, defect, novelty or trained benefit is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent W2 except shared confidence logits += existing_max_overlap * learned_zero_vector2. Exactly two new parameters, no RNG; no new mask statistic, graph, data or selector. Keep original all128 queries/all channels, overlap formula/diagonal/padding/mass, full inputs/2D/backbone/coordinates/sampling/SCG/k/gamma, original shared head/norms/masks/gates/targets/loss/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML.
